fit: native tile 16x16, anchor bottom-centre (8,16); stage 384x224 at 16 px per tile; a knight is 12x20.
geometry: Each tile is one 16x16 cell; collision is the tile and belongs to the rules (the spike tile hurts only its lower ten rows); art never sets a hitbox.
timing: stone 1 ticks; snow 1 ticks; ledge 1 ticks; spikes 1 ticks; hatch 1 ticks; hatch-open 2x4 ticks (30 Hz). Durations are the rules' and live in assets/bannerpeak/slots.json.
